usage: Choose and combine only purposes supported by this video; write source-reviewed narrative_sections.text. Purpose/evidence fields stay internal.
format_detection: Use actual video format and content, not duration alone to call a video Shorts.

long_form.goal: Useful consultation depth proportional to what the clip actually explains

suggested_purposes.prompt: What problem or decision does this clip address? Explain the context without inventing this customer's own need.
What is worth watching in this vehicle/product case, and what visual or spoken evidence supports it?
What does a stated feature allow the owner to choose or understand? Keep the supported usage meaning next to the feature; do not infer brightness/safety from watts or Kelvin.
Which actual trade-off or fitment point helps the owner choose? Explain why it matters; select useful points instead of listing the full workshop checklist.
Include only when relevant and verified. Use public_commercial policy; keep full commercial source facts internal.
One easy action and the essential information needed for advice.

shorts.goal: Compact explanation matching the actual moment, question or feature shown

suggested_purposes.prompt: State what this clip actually shows or answers in a natural opening.
Add the supported meaning or necessary limitation if the clip contains it; omit unsupported sections.
Use a short relevant action when needed; no forced long-form storyline.

retain: Explain the owner's problem or decision
Answer a natural vehicle-owner question with enough context
gem_style_selection.source_note: Principles supplied by user; not a claim to have read an unprovided original Gem document.

render_contract.narrative_sections: Each included section has non-empty text, purpose and reviewed evidence; only complete text enters public copy
render_contract.text_preservation: Strip outer whitespace only; never summarize/truncate to hit a word count
render_contract.optional_sections: Select by content and format, not a mandatory checklist
render_contract.overflow: Raise error beyond platform limit; editor revises explicitly
render_contract.signature: Render only from channel.signature_template, no independent template copy
